title: affaan-m/ECC
lede: ECC is an MIT-licensed bundle of agents, skills, hooks and memory that installs a plan, test, review and remember loop into coding agents, built first for Claude Code with adapters for Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and others.

points: Ships 72 agents, 327 skills and 98 legacy command shims, plus hooks, selectable rule packs, session memory and continuous learning.
AgentShield, included, scans prompts, hooks, MCP config, permissions, secrets and agent files.
Claude Code is the best-supported harness; Codex and Qoder get native plugin paths, while Gemini, Zed, Copilot and others get capability-limited adapters.
Release 2.2 adds a guided installer that configures Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code in one reviewed pass, with a dry-run mode.
The README warns against installing twice into the same harness, which duplicates skills, hooks and commands; a paid ECC Pro GitHub App covers private repos.
